subject: a narrow stream under snow-covered cedar
pose: stream leading from foreground to middle
art_direction: 杉树下的一段窄溪穿过柔雪，暖褐石头在底部留出清晰质感。
visible_description: 杉树下的一段窄溪穿过柔雪，暖褐石头在底部留出清晰质感。
composition: Native vertical 1024x1536 phone wallpaper. Design the full tall canvas with convincing depth, elegant leading lines and a strongly resolved focal scene in the middle and lower areas. Leave the upper roughly 20% naturally quiet for a lock-screen clock, using open sky, mist, water, a wall or a gentle color field; do not draw any clock or UI. Do not put essential faces or details at the extreme sides. Use a full-bleed rectangular composition, no border, no circular frame. Let scale, texture, atmosphere and beautiful lighting create the impact. Preserve clarity instead of filling every area with ornament.
creative_direction: Illustrate a narrow stream moving through soft snow beneath low cedar branches. Concentrate warm-brown stones and clear water reflections at the bottom, letting the stream narrow toward a muted middle distance. Snow rests in broad rounded shapes rather than sparkling flakes. Diffuse cold daylight and a faint warm reflection create gentle movement within an otherwise still, spacious scene. Vertical 1024x1536. Reserve the upper twenty percent as naturally quiet negative space, keeping detail lower in the composition. Original peaceful image, no text, branding, or watermark.
